lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What is the mandatory legal duty when approaching a pedestrian carrying a white cane or using a service guide dog?

options.text: Tap your horn gently to notify the pedestrian of your vehicle location
Take all necessary precautions, come to a complete stop, and yield right-of-way
Proceed at standard speed if your travel lane displays a solid green light
Direct the pedestrian verbally through open driver window to cross street
